events.title: 슈루즈버리 타운 beat 에버턴 2–1 in an FA Cup third round tie at Gay Meadow .
Robbie Keane scores a hat-trick as 토트넘 홋스퍼 beat 에버턴 4–3 in the league at White Hart Lane .
Thierry Henry scores a hat-trick as 아스널 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–1 at Highbury .
Dutch club 스파르타 로테르담 fires manager Dolf Roks , who is replaced on 7 February by former player Chris Dekker .
Head coach Robert Maaskant leaves 고 어헤드 이글스 and returns to RBC Roosendaal .
Still struggling with debt, 리즈 유나이티드 sell Robbie Fowler to 맨체스터 시티 for £6million.

January draws to a close with 아스널 still top of the Premier League, two points above second placed 맨체스터 유나이티드 and within a game in hand. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 첼시 and 에버턴 complete the top five. 리버풀's decline continues as they occupy eighth place, deepening fears that a side looking all set for title glory three months ago might now not even qualify for the UEFA Cup. Meanwhile, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언's dismal form continues as they and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 prop up the rest of the top flight on goal difference. 선덜랜드 occupy the last relegation place. 미들즈브러 boost their bid for a UEFA Cup place by spending a total of £8.5million on new signings Chris Riggott , Malcolm Christie and Michael Ricketts . The true extent of 리즈 유나이티드's financial difficulties becomes public knowledge during a press conference to announce the sale of Jonathan Woodgate to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 for £9million, during which 테리 베너블스 states that he had been assured players wouldn't need to be sold. 포츠머스 and 레스터 시티 remain in pole position at the top of Division One, and apart from 코번트리 시티 edging Reading out of the playoff zone the top six of the division is unchanged from last month.
